final: WITH pa AS (SELECT p.player_id AS player_id, p.bats AS bats, AVG(b."double") AS avg_doubles FROM batting_postseason b JOIN player p ON p.player_id = b.player_id WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.bats) <> '' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.bats), idx AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, avg_doubles / (SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) FROM pa) AS idx FROM pa) SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx, idx - AVG(idx) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS diff_from_hand_avg FROM idx ORDER BY diff_from_hand_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
